instruction: Find complete information (address, contact number, and website) for Cristal Room by Anne-Sophie Pic and Leela restaurants on Google Maps, then fill all the details in the spreadsheet.

metadata.explanation: Task asks agent to find complete information (address, phone, website) for Cristal Room by Anne-Sophie Pic (row 3) and Leela (row 4). The evaluator checks that both restaurants have all 3 fields filled. Full score (1.0) if both rows complete, partial credit based on total filled cells (e.g., 4/6 cells = 0.67).

scoring_breakdown.0.17-0.83: Partial: some fields filled (1-5 out of 6 cells)
scoring_breakdown.1.0: Complete: both restaurants have all 3 fields (address, phone, website) filled

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements: both restaurants (rows 3, 4) and all 3 fields (address, phone, website) per restaurant
Getter logic correctly extracts data from the right rows (3, 4) and columns (B=address, C=phone, D=website)
Metric logic correctly implements full credit (1.0) when both rows are complete and proportional partial credit for partially filled data
Data flow is correct: getter extracts cell values, counts complete rows and filled cells, metric compares against expected requirement
Postconfig appropriately saves the file and activates the window to ensure fresh state
Expected value (required_complete_rows: 2) is semantically correct for the task
Edge cases handled: missing file returns zeros, empty cells validated with None and strip() checks, division by zero prevented
